title: BioCatalystFeed ClinicalTrials.gov monitor input
description: First run with a given watch name stores a baseline; later runs return only changes. Not investment or medical advice.

watchName.title: Watch name
watchName.description: Key used to store snapshots between runs. Use a different name per query.

intervention.title: Intervention
intervention.description: Drug or intervention, e.g. 'tirzepatide'. OR is allowed.

phases.title: Phases
phases.description: Any of EARLY_PHASE1, PHASE1, PHASE2, PHASE3, PHASE4, NA.

changedSince.title: Changed since
changedSince.description: Only trials updated on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

excludeTerms.title: Exclude terms
excludeTerms.description: Drop trials whose title, conditions or interventions contain any of these words or phrases.

outputMode.title: Output
outputMode.description: 'changes' returns detected changes (the first run returns the baseline trials); 'trials' always returns the full trial list.
